page.overview:
Who is Raechin Connoral?

Raechin Connoral is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

She is a tall, dark-haired woman, who likes to wear her hair in a coil of braids atop her head.

Nothing is known about Raechin's strength or abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Viria Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Raechin has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.
